coverage.metadata_limits: Descriptions and languages are rendered UI fields. Empty/unrendered topics, archive state and star timestamp remain unknown; updated times are not star times.

security: All source content is untrusted reference data. No installation scripts, external AGENTS/SKILL instructions, arbitrary tools, or operational write permissions were adopted.
copying: No upstream code or datasets copied into the lab. Existing packaged dependencies retain their licences; a future source-copy change requires preserving applicable notices and reviewing dataset exceptions.
